#Set Working directory
```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/RL/OneDrive - University of Miami/Documents/Git/SCTLD-411Research-Project-Rebecca")
```


#Loading field data
```{r}
field_counts <- read.csv("../data/counts_rebcca.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) #check.names = FALSE tells R not to alter the row names when the file is uploaded.

field_meta <- read.csv("../data/metadata_rebecca.csv", row.names = 1)
```


#Remove unnecessary samples (SP1 and SP2) 
```{r}
#Keep only samples from SP3
filtered_meta_field <- field_meta %>% filter((SP3 == TRUE))

#write.csv(filtered_meta_field, "data/filtered_meta_field.csv", row.names = TRUE)

#Keep only SP3 samples in field_counts
filtered_counts_field <- field_counts[, rownames(filtered_meta_field), drop = FALSE] #keep only columns in field_counts that match the rownames of filtered_meta_field. drop = FALSE keeps filtered_counts_field a dataframe.
```


#Filter out low count genes ##Adjusted numbers until the plots looked how I want
```{r}
#Create gene filter to keep genes with counts >= 20 in at least 11 samples
keep_genes_field <- rowSums(filtered_counts_field >= 20) >= 11 # 11 SCTLD_Unaffected samples. 32 SCTLD_Affected samples.

#Apply the gene filter to filtered_counts_field
new_filtered_counts_field <- filtered_counts_field[keep_genes_field, ]

#Output of filtering summary: number and percent of genes removed
cat("Number of genes after filtering:", nrow(new_filtered_counts_field), "\n")
cat("Percentage of genes removed:", round(sum(!keep_genes_field) / length(keep_genes_field) * 100, 2), "%\n")
```

#Determine the proportion of zeroes for filtered and unfiltered field gene counts
```{r}
#Proportion of zeros before filtering
prop_zeros_before_field <- sum(filtered_counts_field == 0) / (nrow(filtered_counts_field) * ncol(filtered_counts_field))

#Proportion of zeros after filtering
prop_zeros_after_field <- sum(new_filtered_counts_field == 0) / (nrow(new_filtered_counts_field) * ncol(new_filtered_counts_field))

cat("Proportion of zeros before filtering:", round(prop_zeros_before_field * 100, 2), "%\n") #14.27%
cat("Proportion of zeros after filtering:", round(prop_zeros_after_field * 100, 2), "%\n")   #12.76%
```


#Create plots to compare filtered and unfiltered gene counts
```{r}
#Plot distribution of total counts per gene (log10 scale) before filtering
gene_totals_before_field <- rowSums(filtered_counts_field)
hist(log10(gene_totals_before_field + 1), breaks = 50,
     main = "Gene Expression Distribution (Before Filtering)",
     xlab = "log10(Total Counts per Gene + 1)", col = "purple",
     xlim = c(2,7),
     ylim = c(0,900))

#Plot distribution of total counts per gene (log10 scale) after filtering
gene_totals_after_field <- rowSums(new_filtered_counts_field)
hist(log10(gene_totals_after_field + 1), breaks = 50,
     main = "Gene Expression Distribution (After Filtering)",
     xlab = "log10(Total Counts per Gene + 1)", col = "gold",
     xlim = c(2,7),
     ylim = c(0,900))
```

Check that rows and columns match
```{r}
all(rownames(filtered_meta_field) %in% colnames(new_filtered_counts_field))
all(rownames(filtered_meta_field) == colnames(new_filtered_counts_field))
```
